title: Paper-chain transplanting sled
engineering: 44 mm guide maintains 2.977 mm modeled clearance over 50 plug stations. The 34 mm control fails the clearance gate at every station.
physical_check: Fit an actual chain and run 50 plugs. Verify snags and depth on ten plugs.

title: Narrow-bed harvest broadfork
engineering: Thicker socket section lowers model bending stress from 174.143 to 72.222 MPa. NT$150 additional cost erases estimated first-unit savings.
physical_check: Measure soil loads and inspect the installed handles during proof and 50 insertions.

title: Greenhouse relative light survey bar
engineering: Gain and offset calibration reduces worst synthetic uniform spread from 36.40% to 4.55%.
physical_check: Compare three normalized channels within 5% under uniform light and confirm two filter ranks.

title: Rainfall event pulse recorder
engineering: Two synthetic rate traces yield 0.94% depth error with zero duplicates. Long lockout undercounts the faster rate by 50.47%.
physical_check: Deliver weighed water at two rates. Verify depth error within 5% and no duplicated pulses.

title: Shallow-channel current survey wand
engineering: Calibrated pulse replay shows 0.014 m/s worst synthetic error versus 0.154 m/s without an intercept. Stalls produce no reading.
physical_check: Fit the actual rotor in a flume and compare three held-out velocities. Measure stall and repeatability.

title: Fish fingerling size grader
engineering: Two gap profiles classify 100% in a rigid-coupon model. The larger yaw control classifies 83%.
physical_check: Check both physical gaps on 100 inert profiles and inspect for burrs.

title: Hatchery low-flow air distribution panel
engineering: Four-branch model predicts at most 4.97% redistribution on a stiff source versus 23.98% in the droop control.
physical_check: Reference-check all four readouts at three settings on an empty-vessel air rig and isolate each branch.
